ArchivedFilter.description: Which Threads `thread list` returns with respect to archiving (#222).

ConfigChange.description:
One named change to the configuration file. `field` is a TOML dotted key;
a missing or null `value` removes the key so its default applies again.

ConnectionTestArgs.description:
Test a saved connection by `connection`, or a candidate that is not saved by
`base_url` (with optional `api`, `api_key` or `api_key_env`, `api_key_header`,
`ssl_verify`). Exactly one of the two forms.

CredentialsSetArgs.description: The key is write-only: Debug and every reply leave it out.

EventCursor.description: Opaque cursor: the owner instance that issued it and a position of that instance's change clock.
EventCursor.title: EventCursor

ExecutionContext.description: Missing fields mean unrecorded or inapplicable, never inferred execution facts.

lifetime_ms.description: Closed wall-clock lifetime, including preparation and waiting.

Origin.description: Token is deliberately excluded from Debug to avoid logging shell credentials.
Origin.title: Origin

PageCursor.description: Versioned opaque page cursor. Scope, filters, and revision bind it to one query.
PageCursor.title: PageCursor

awaiting_human_count.description: Pending human-directed replies: exact through 16; 17 with exact=false means 17 or more.

ToolFieldAvailability.description: Availability of a single exact structural tool field, never body completeness.

elapsed_ms.description: Read-time duration for live shells; saved duration for terminal shells.

opaque_result_note: A true operation schema means the result is opaque JSON, not yet represented by a stable Rust result record.
